messages.content: I need to take a screenshot of the current website shown in Google Chrome. How can i achieve this with Python ?

message.reasoning:
The user wants to take a screenshot of the current website shown in Google Chrome using Python. They likely want to capture the visible area of the Chrome window. We can use Selenium WebDriver with Chrome driver to open Chrome and take screenshot. But they want to capture the current website shown in Chrome, maybe already open? Selenium cannot capture an existing Chrome instance unless you attach to it via remote debugging port. Alternatively, we can use pyautogui to capture the screen region. Or use pywinauto to find Chrome window and capture screenshot. Or use pychrome to connect to Chrome DevTools protocol.

We should ask clarifying question: do they want to capture the currently open tab in Chrome? Or just open a new Chrome instance? Also, do they have ChromeDriver installed? Provide instructions accordingly.
